mapper.sql: id, plan_no, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, version, active_plan_key, completed_version, default_audience_count, selected_audience_count, idempotency_token, order_request_id, order_id, expire_time, confirmed_at, completed_at, submitted_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_purchase_plan ( plan_no, user_id, show_id, session_id, ticket_category_id, quantity, status, version, active_plan_key, completed_version, default_audience_count, selected_audience_count, idempotency_token, order_request_id, order_id, expire_time, confirmed_at, completed_at, submitted_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{planNo}, #{userId}, #{showId}, #{sessionId}, #{ticketCategoryId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0), #{activePlanKey}, #{completedVersion}, COALESCE(#{defaultAudienceCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{selectedAudienceCount}, 0), #{idempotencyToken}, #{orderRequestId}, #{orderId}, #{expireTime}, #{confirmedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{submittedAt}, #{failReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_purchase_plan AS p SET status = #{expiredStatus}, active_plan_key = NULL, version = version + 1, fail_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE p.status = 'DRAFT' AND p.session_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_session ps WHERE ps.id = p.session_id AND ps.sale_start_time IS NOT NULL AND ps.sale_start_time <= #{now} ) ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE ticket_purchase_plan AS p SET status = #{expiredStatus}, active_plan_key = NULL, version = version + 1, fail_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE p.status = 'READY' AND p.session_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_session ps WHERE ps.id = p.session_id AND ps.sale_end_time IS NOT NULL AND ps.sale_end_time <= #{now} ) ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
